ASSURANCE EXPORT 
 
BPIFRANCE ASSURANCE EXPORT'S PERSONAL DATA 
PROTECTION POLICY  
 
Updated on 31/01/2024  
 
The purpose of this Bpifrance Assurance Export Personal Data Protection Policy (hereinafter "the Policy") is to 
inform the persons concerned by the processing of personal data implemented by Bpifrance Assurance Export in 
its capacity as data controller in the context of its activities.  
 
In accordance with the applicable regulations, in particular European Regulation 2016/679, known as the General 
Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the national provisions relating to information technology, files and 
freedoms, Bpifrance Assurance Export , as data controller, collects and processes your personal data:  
 
• On the basis of the performance of the contract for the following purposes: processing of the request and 
examination of the file, preparation and provision of pre -contractual documentation, establishment of 
contractual documentation, notification of the d ecision, management of the contractual relationship, 
retention of the elements of the file, management of any claims, litigation and claims  ; 
• On the basis of a legal obligation to which Bpifrance is subject for the following purposes: Know Your 
Customer (KYC), fight against money laundering and terrorist financing, fight against corruption, carrying 
out due diligence in terms of international sa nctions and embargoes, prevention of fraud, compliance with 
any other legal or regulatory provision to which Bpifrance Assurance Export is subject, in particular the 
GDPR and the French Data Protection Act.  ». And for electronically signed documentation: o verall 
management of the electronic signature and establishment of the body of evidence contributing to the 
reliability of the electronic signature process;  
• On the basis of Bpifrance Assurance Export's legitimate interest in managing and developing its relations 
with prospects and policyholders for the following purposes: management of the commercial relationship 
between Bpifrance Assurance Export and its cust omers and prospects, establishment of reports and 
statistics, commercial prospecting, sending of newsletters.  
• On the basis of the legitimate interest of Bpifrance Assurance Export  in order to protect itself against fraud 
and provide evidence in the event of litigation for the purpose of verifying the identity of the signatory via 
an advanced electronic signature process.  
 
In this context, Bpifrance Assurance Export is required to collect, directly or indirectly, the following categories of 
personal data from contact points, shareholders, managers, beneficial owners and any person whose data is 
necessary for the processing and processing of requests and/or the management of the contractual relationship:  
 
• Identification data: title, surname, first name, date and place of birth, personal postal address, mobile 
phone number, nationality, country of residence, identity documents (including passport and national 
identity card : date and place of issue of the identity document, expiry date of the identity document, photo 
on the identity document, MRZ strip of the identity document ), photo, signature (electronic or 
handwritten);  
• Administrative data: proof of address;  
• Data relating to professional life: professional postal address, professional telephone number, 
professional e -mail address, position/position within the company, curriculum vitae;  
• Business login data; IP address and authentication on the portal (procedure token, electronic signature 
certificate)  
• Economic and financial data: bank details, tax situation, SIREN.

The data is intended for Bpifrance Assurance Export and may also be communicated:  
 
• To the State, in the case of schemes managed in the name, on behalf of and under the control of the State;  
• To any French or European administrative, judicial, arbitral or supervisory authority that needs to be aware 
of it in the context of administrative, judicial or arbitral proceedings that benefits from a right of 
communication based on a legislative provisi on in the context of French or European administrative or 
judicial proceedings, at their request;  
• To other entities of the Bpifrance Group for commercial prospecting purposes, for example to inform us 
of its new products or any changes to existing products, with the exception of personal data that the Banks 
have provided to us and which concern them;  
 
Subject to having informed of the confidential nature of the information transmitted:  
 
• In the context of credit insurance products and the guarantee of strategic projects, to entities intervening 
directly or indirectly within the framework of reinsurance or joint insurance agreements;  
• To other entities of the Bpifrance group, as soon as such transmission is necessary to enable these entities 
to meet their legal or regulatory obligations. This transmission of intra -group information does not in any 
way exempt the entities of the Bpifranc e group from the legal, regulatory or contractual confidentiality 
obligations (including the rules defined in agreement with the State) that apply to them with regard to third 
parties;  
• To its professional advisors , auditors  
• And for electronically signed documentation: to the trusted service providers Yousign and Netheos to 
which Bpifrance Assurance Export uses for the implementation of the advanced electronic signature 
process , it being specified that there will be no obligation to inform these persons in this way if they are 
subject to professional secrecy or are otherwise bound by obligations of professional secrecy. 
confidentiality.  
 
Personal data is kept by Bpifrance  Assurance Export  for a period not exceeding that necessary to achieve the 
purposes specified above, increased, where applicable, by the French and European legal and regulatory limitation 
periods.  
 
When the information contained in this Policy is provided to a legal entity, the latter undertakes to inform the 
natural persons concerned of the processing of personal data carried out by Bpifrance Assurance Export by making 
this Policy available to them.  
 
 
In accordance with the applicable regulations, and subject to the conditions set out therein for the exercise of 
these rights, you benefit from:  
 
• A right of access, rectification, deletion, as well as the right to portability of your personal data;  
• The right to request the limitation of the processing that concerns you and to object to receiving 
commercial prospecting or to being subject to profiling related to commercial prospecting. In some cases, 
you may, for reasons relating to your particular si tuation, object to the processing of this data, including 
profiling;  
• The right to withdraw your consent for processing based on it;  
• The right to organize the fate of your personal data post -mortem.  
 
 
The above -mentioned rights may be exercised by contacting Bpifrance's  Data Protection Officer at the postal 
address "Data Protection Officer (DPO), Bpifrance, DCCP, 27 -31 avenue du Général Leclerc, 94710 Maisons -Alfort" 
or at the e -mail address donneespersonnelles@bpifrance.fr . 
 
You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the CNIL.

that Bpifrance can offer.

2024 FINANCIAL RESULTS 
ROBUST PERFORMANCE: NET INCOME OF 986 MILLION EUROS  
 
 
 
PERFORMANCE 
 
In 2024, Bpifrance injected €60bn1 into the French economy. This high level of activity was accompanied by robust 
financial performance. 
 
In 2024, net consolidated income remained at a high level of €896m. 
 
The Net Banking Income, for a total of €2.1bn, is comprised of:  
• A net interest margin of €720m, up 9% during a year characterised by long -term interest rate instability; 
• Dividends received from direct equity interests, which remain at an exceptional level of €613m (+3%);  
• A contribution from the Fund of Funds business that , at €140m,  remains moderate due to new caution 
surrounding risk capital valuations and despite the positive signal of a very strong upturn in distributions. 
 
The increase in expenditure reflects the growth of our activities and is in compliance with our management ratios  
(operating ratio* for the banking business line and expense ratio* for the Investment business).  
 
The rise in the cost of risk reflects a normalisation of the cost of proven risk  following the exceptionally low post -
Covid years and a lower write-back of provisions for expected cost of risk. 
 
The contribution to income of holdings in equity-consolidated companies* is down by 42% at €183m  as a result of 
the fall in STMicroelectronics’ net income in 2024. 
 
In addition to net income, Bpifrance’s overall performance is evaluated over the long -term through the change in the 
value of its portfolios. The change in value of Bpifrance since its creation in 2013 is €13.9bn , i.e. average annual 
performance of 5.2%. 
 
FINANCIAL ROBUSTNESS 
The robustness of the financial structure is confirmed at the top level  by ratios that far exceed regulatory 
requirements:   
• Bpifrance’s solvency remains robust: the CET1* ratio stands at 27.36% compared to a regulatory requirement 
for overall solvency of 13.27% (excluding Pillar 2 Guidance);  
• Bpifrance boasts an exceptional liquidity position with a liquidity coverage ratio (LCR*) of 280%  (prudential 
requirement of 100%), as well as a liquidity reserve of €19.7bn.

Methodological notes 
Equity-consolidated companies (ECC) : equity interests over which the Group exercises joint control or significant influence are 
accounted for using the equity method. This consists of replacing the value of the securities by the share that the Group hol ds in 
the equity and income of the com panies in question. Thus, the income statement reflects the Group’s share in the income of the 
companies accounted for using the equity method and when an impairment is noted, this is charged to the equity -consolidated 
holding on the balance sheet, which allows for the subsequent reversal of the impairment in the event of an improvement to the 
going concern or market value. 
 
ROE:  
• Numerator: net income for year N 
• Denominator: shareholder’s equity (including annual income) at end of year N 
 
Operating ratio: ratio comparing operating expenditure to net banking income 
 
Expense ratio: ratio comparing operating expenditure to Assets under Management (Bpifrance Participations) 
 
LCR ratio: Liquidity Coverage Ratio (1 month), comparing high-quality liquid assets to net total cash outflow 
 
CET1 Ratio: Core Equity Tier 1 ratio, comparing core equity capital to risk-weighted assets 
 
Furthermore, due to rounding rules, the sum of the values appearing in the tables and analyses may differ slightly from the total 
shown.

Notice 
 
The aim of this press release is to illustrate the activities and results of the Bpifrance Group for 2024. It provides an overview of the activities of the 
main Bpifrance business lines and presents financial information for the financial year ending 31 December 2024. The data presented in this press 
release has not been audited. The figures it contains are taken from internal approved sources and from the accounts (corpora te and/or 
consolidated) of Bpifrance Participations, Bpifrance Investissement and Bpifrance for the 2024 financial year. These accounts have been approved 
by the Boards of Directors of these companies on 13 and 14 March 2024, and have been certified by the external auditors. They will be submitted to 
the shareholders of these companies for approval on 22 May 2024. 
  
This press release may contain objectives and commentary on Bpifrance’s objectives and strategy. By their nature, these objectives are based on 
assumptions, project-specific considerations, objectives and expectations related to events, and future and unce rtain operations, products and

objectives, which are subject to inherent risks, uncertainties and assumptions re lated to Bpifrance, its subsidiaries and its investments, to the 
development of the activities of Bpifrance and its subsidiaries, sector trends, future investments and acquisitions, the evolution of the economic 
climate, and of the main markets of Bpifranc e, to the competition and to regulations. These events are uncertain, their outcome may differ from 
that anticipated today, which is likely to have a significant impact on the expected results. The actual results may differ s ubstantially from those 
mentioned in the objectives. The information contained in this press release, insofar as it relates to parties other than Bpifrance or it is taken from 
external sources, has not been independently verified and no statement or commitment is given in regard thereto . Furthermore, no certainty can 
be given as regards the correctness, sincerity, accuracy and exhaustive nature of the information or opinions contained in th is press release. 
Neither Bpifrance nor its representatives may be held liable for any negligence or any harm that may result from the use of this press release or its

About Bpifrance:  
 
Bpifrance finances businesses, at each stage of their development, through loans, guarantees and equity. Bpifrance  
supports them in their innovation and international projects. Bpifrance also insures their export activities through a 
broad range of products. Advice, a university, networking and an accelerator programme for start-ups, SMEs and mid-
caps are also offered to entrepreneurs.  
Thanks to Bpifrance and its 50 regional offices, entrepreneurs can count on a local, single and efficient interlocutor 
to guide them through the challenges they face.
